caption: The drawing depicts a women's outfit consisting of a long skirt and a matching jacket with a blouse underneath. The skirt is floor-length, gently flared, and shaded in shades of soft lavender and light purple with some subtle blue hues, giving a sense of volume and folds in the fabric. The matching jacket is also lavender, with a high waist and wide lapels that are fastened with a belt-like band at the waist. The jacket has long sleeves, ending in cuffs, and is accented by a series of buttons along the upper arm on each side. Underneath the jacket, the blouse is white and intricately patterned with a swirling embroidered design that covers the bodice and sleeves. The jacket’s sleeves are pushed up to reveal the ornate lower sleeves of the blouse. The outfit is displayed without a head, hands, or feet, and is set against a plain, light beige background.
title: Afternoon Gown
